name: Deepcon
blurb: A long-running Italian science-fiction, fantasy and horror convention held at the Ambasciatori Place Hotel in Fiuggi.
notes: Deepcon 26 ran May 7-10, 2026 at the Ambasciatori Place Hotel, Fiuggi (confirmed via fantasymagazine.it / ds1.it press coverage: 'Deepcon 26 in programma dal 7 al 10 maggio'); that edition already ended well before the research window. Deepcon 27 (2027) dates have not been announced on the official site as of this check, so no edition is listed.
